findings.claim: runGuard splices stdout and stderr with no separator: a partial stdout line glued onto stderr's first line can carry a crash banner (or its Error header) off line-start, so classify falls through looksLikeCrash to the attribution check and can certify a crashing guard REACHABLE — the F1 false pass, reopened for module-not-found shapes
findings.proof: stdout 'violation at tools/<probe>' with no trailing newline + stderr whose first line is 'Error: Cannot find module ...' glues to '...mjsError: Cannot find module' — no clause matches line-anchored; empirical: old law true, new law false. Real Node uncaught crashes carry a location header as stderr's first line, so the live window is the caught-and-reprinted shape — the bearer-citation power

findings.claim: the two banner regression cases pin hand-crafted string constants; no end-to-end case drives a REAL Node module-not-found banner through looksLikeCrash, so a future banner-format drift keeps the constants green while real crashes degrade from GATE_DEFECT to UNREACHABLE — misdiagnosis, not a false pass

residual of the cured class: a findings-register claim that QUOTES a whole crash banner across an embedded newline renders banner-at-column-0 through any guard that emits register text, and the line-anchored law still classifies the honest refusal GATE_DEFECT — fails closed, but the incident shape survives one newline away from the fixed one
findings.justification: shape-only residual: prose that quotes a whole crash banner across an embedded newline renders banner-at-line-start and is indistinguishable from a real banner by shape alone; the misread fails CLOSED (a blocked gate, never a false pass), which is the same plain-text trust class the records themselves live in; the tool header now states this boundary instead of claiming closure

findings.claim: the repair's own law comment overstates closure: 'only a banner is a crash' is falsified by schema-legal multiline claims quoting a captured banner (validateFindings permits newlines; retrospective renders verbatim), re-arming the exact vendor blockage this wave cures

pre-existing, not introduced by this diff: six self-testing tools in the battery (vendor-drift, retrospective, path-obligations, bench/grade, zcode-plugin gate-law, agreement-check) appear in neither guards[] nor notRegistered[] of docs/gates/guard-reach.json, so the 'stated, never faked' entry-bar law is prose without a machine check
